name: Wolf Gold Ultimate

features.name: Hold and respin
features.description: Six cash moons trigger three respins that reset with every new cash prize.

features.name: Extra grids
features.description: Landing 2, 11 or 25 moons unlocks additional respin grids, up to 50 prizes.

features.name: Four jackpots
features.description: Mini, Minor, Major and Grand jackpots.

review:
Classic Wolf Gold with a much bigger respin. Mustangs, mountain lions and wolf wilds, and six or more cash moons trigger hold and respin with three spins that reset on every new value.

The upgrade is extra grids: two, 11 or 25 moons unlock a second, third and fourth grid, so the feature can hold up to 50 cash prizes. Mini, Minor, Major and Grand jackpots too. Up to 5,000x, 96.5% RTP. Far more room to grow than the original.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
